title: DroidProxy request journal v1
description: One best-effort request observation. Null means unknown, not zero. Semantic and storage rules are in request-journal-v1.md.

execution_id.description: CLIProxyAPI request UUID from the trace header; otherwise a locally minted UUIDv4.

trace_id.description: Unmodified X-CPA-TRACE-ID response header value, or null when absent.

started_at.description: UTC time when the forwarding attempt begins, including backend dialing.

ended_at.description: UTC time when the observation is finalized, once.

latency_ms.description: Elapsed monotonic milliseconds from forwarding attempt to finalization.

ttft_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds to the first response entity-body byte; excludes headers and transfer framing. Null if none arrived.

origin.description: Primer only for the internal X-DroidProxy-Origin: window-primer marker, stripped before forwarding.

endpoint.description: Original client request path without query, before any path rewrite.

forwarded_endpoint.description: Forwarded path without query only when a rewrite changed it; otherwise null.

provider.description: Request family derived from the original model and endpoint, never proof of a billing seat.

requested_model.description: Original request model before alias rewrites; path model for native Gemini; null if unavailable.

response_model.description: Last nonempty model explicitly reported in the observed response, or null.

status.description: Final upstream HTTP status observed, even if client delivery fails. Null before a status line; own dial-failure 502 is the sole exception.

outcome.description: Relay termination, independent of HTTP success and usage availability; see the exit-path table.

seat.description: Trace-selected seat. Null without a usable trace index; index and role only when identity cannot safely be resolved.

client_session.description: First valid explicit client session key in the documented precedence; null if none. No truncation, hashing, or affinity prefixes.

tokens.description: Terminal observed usage only; null for missing, incomplete, malformed, unsupported, or compressed usage.

auth_index.description: Second trace segment, identifying the last selected CLIProxyAPI auth.

role.description: Served on 2xx only; last_tried otherwise. Not evidence of complete usage or spend.

file.description: Auth file basename, never its contents or absolute path.

email.description: Explicit auth identity email, not a billing-ownership fallback.

org.description: Claude organization_uuid or nested organization identity.

input_uncached.description: Uncached input; OpenAI input or prompt total minus reported cached input.

cache_read.description: Input read from cache; zero only when known, including protocol-defined absent cache details.

cache_creation.description: Reported cache-creation input; null if unavailable. Always null for Responses v1 normalization.

output.description: Total output including reasoning; do not add reasoning again.

reasoning.description: Reported reasoning output subset, or null when not separately available.
